The strongest **Bloomerang alternatives** in 2026 are **Keela, Givebutter, Donorbox, Little Green Light, and Raiser’s Edge NXT** according to G2’s competitor rankings and user ratings.[2] If you want lower-cost or fundraising-first options, **4aGoodCause**, **Funraise**, **Zeffy**, and **Give Lively** also come up as notable alternatives in nonprofit-focused comparisons.[5][6][7]

Here’s the clearest way to think about them:

| Alternative | Best for | Notable strength |
|---|---|---|
| **Keela** | Small to mid-sized nonprofits | Strong all-in-one nonprofit CRM and high user ratings[2] |
| **Givebutter** | Organizations wanting fundraising + CRM | Very highly rated and popular with nonprofits[2] |
| **Donorbox** | Donation-driven teams | Strong online giving tools and broad adoption[2] |
| **Little Green Light** | Budget-conscious nonprofits | Simpler donor management at a lower complexity level[2][5] |
| **Raiser’s Edge NXT** | Larger, more complex nonprofits | More enterprise-level nonprofit CRM capabilities[2] |
| **4aGoodCause** | Small nonprofits | Emphasizes fundraising efficiency and ease of use[5] |
| **Funraise** | Donor retention and fundraising growth | Positioned as a strong Bloomerang alternative for improving donor retention[6] |
| **Zeffy / Give Lively** | Very budget-limited nonprofits | Free/low-cost options mentioned for constrained budgets[7] |

Bloomerang itself frames its alternatives mainly as direct comparisons with **DonorPerfect, Bonterra Network for Good, Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge, and Blackbaud eTapestry**, which is useful if you’re comparing CRM-style platforms rather than donation-only tools.[1]

If you want the best match by use case:
- **Best overall alternative:** **Givebutter** or **Keela**[2]
- **Best budget option:** **Little Green Light**[2][5]
- **Best for fundraising-first teams:** **Donorbox** or **Funraise**[2][6]
- **Best for larger nonprofits:** **Raiser’s Edge NXT**[2]

If you want, I can also narrow this down to the **best Bloomerang alternative for your nonprofit size, budget, and must-have features**.
